subtitle: Lesson 12 · Cloud Encryption: At Rest and In Transit

eyebrow: TLS does double duty in the cloud
code:
Client  --TLS-->  Cloud service
   (browser, script, app)

Service --TLS--> Service
   (web app -> database -> storage)

Every network hop needs a cover.
caption: Public internet or inside the provider's own network — TLS covers the hop either way.

code:
Azure Storage Account
  Secure transfer required: ON (default)
  Plain HTTP request -> REJECTED

Amazon S3 bucket policy
  Deny if aws:SecureTransport = false
caption: "TLS is available" became "TLS is required unless you turn it off."

code:
TLS 1.0 / 1.1   -> refused
TLS 1.2         -> minimum accepted
TLS 1.3         -> increasingly supported

No silent downgrade to an older version.
caption: Using "TLS" isn't enough — the version itself has to clear a floor.
